title: Wander Through the Frame
description: A woman in a long green coat stands in a decaying room with peeling floral wallpaper, reaching toward a wall covered in old photographs, film strips, and the number 391. Through a large broken picture frame overgrown with vines, a surreal landscape of misty mountains and a dramatic sunset is visible, blending interior and exterior worlds.
prompt: A woman in a vintage green coat stands inside a decaying ornate room with peeling floral wallpaper and scattered old framed photographs on the mossy floor. She reaches toward the wall which displays film strips and the number 391. A large golden picture frame on the wall is broken and overgrown with white flowers and vines, revealing a vast misty mountain valley with dramatic sunset sky beyond, surreal blend of interior ruin and epic landscape, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting
